import torch
from torch import nn

def test():
    device = torch.device("cuda:0")
    model = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Linear(10, 12),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Linear(12, 3)
    )
    loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    x = torch.randn(3, 10)
    y = torch.zeros(3)
    preds = model(x)
    preds = preds.view(-1, preds.size(-1)) #flatten the output of the last layer
    label = torch.tensor(preds.argmax(dim=-1), dtype=torch.long) #get the index of the maximum value
    loss = loss_fn(preds, label)
    return preds, label

if __name__ == '__main__':
    preds, label = test()
    print(preds)
    print(label)
